+  public void testResultLevelCacheWithMultiplePostAggregators() throws IOException

+          .setDataSource(QueryRunnerTestHelper.DATA_SOURCE)

+              )
+          )
+          .setGranularity(granularity)
+          .build();
+      final CacheStrategy<ResultRow, Object, GroupByQuery> strategy =
+          new GroupByQueryQueryToolChest(null).getCacheStrategy(query);

+                               ? ResultRow.of(123L, "#en.wikipedia", null, 10516, 21032, 31548)
+                               : ResultRow.of("#en.wikipedia", null, 10516, 21032, 31548);
+

+          objectMapper.writeValueAsBytes(strategy.prepareForCache(true).apply(result)),

+      );

+    }
